correctness.rationale: All k+1 marker one-starting and sum(g_j) zero-starting rotations are distinct because g_k is a unique maximum. A zero-starting rotation with t leading zeros sorts first for larger t; within a fixed t bucket the subsequent distinct zero gaps order the eligible j indices as k−1,...,m,k, so predecessor letters are 1 exactly at t=g_j. Counting intervening bucket sizes produces the full 1,0^(d_k−1),1, product_j 0^((k−j+1)d_j)1, 0^(kd_1),1,0 expression and run count 2k+2−2[d_k=1]. Explicit one-starting tail and k=2 empty product were checked. Independently sorted every full cyclic rotation for 1089 increment vectors d_i∈{1,2,3}, 2<=k<=6; full output strings matched.
